name: codoc-study-logger
description: Records which files a study participant opens, looks at, and edits. Runs in both conditions.

codocStudyLogger.file.description: Where to append the log. Defaults to ~/codoc-study/session-logs/interaction-<workspace>.jsonl

codocStudyLogger.participant.description: Participant code, written into every line.

codocStudyLogger.condition.description: Which condition this project is, written by setup. Left empty, nothing is sent to the study database, because the alternative is filing a session under the wrong arm.

codocStudyLogger.studyPage.description: Where the participant page is served. Left empty, the deployed one is used.

codocStudyLogger.order.description: Which way round this participant goes. Set during setup.

codocStudyLogger.snapshots.description: Record the project every few seconds, so the session can be replayed. On by default: this used to be a script somebody had to remember to start.

codocStudyLogger.snapshotEverySeconds.description: How often to record the project, in seconds.

commands.title: Study logger: show what is being recorded
